post.description:
Ask one person for an interview.

For a member of the organization (``recipient.user_id``, with ``project_id``)
the request lands in their interview inbox and they are notified. Only a
project owner or admin may ask, and only a member who can take part in the
project's interviews may be asked (422 otherwise, the same answer for an
unknown id or a person in another organization).

For anyone else (``recipient.email``) Beakr saves a sendable interview, makes
a link for them and emails it. The email is never matched to an account.
PHI organizations cannot send outside Beakr (403); a sandbox organization
never sends real email (``email_status: not_sent_sandbox``); one person may
